title: Dashed Borders
description: A notes app layout that sets $borderType to dashed on the header, both sidebars, the sticky ShellMainHeader, and the sticky footer, and tints all of them but the main header with a muted yellow $hue, with a nested NavGroup page tree in the start sidebar and a toggleable end Context sidebar. Use it when shell separators need a dashed or tinted style, or for a document workspace with sidebars on both sides of the content.
